policy: For component-like targets with no direct target-self pronunciation in S03 and no exact GF0023 main-table standard-character row, close the P3 pronunciation field as not applicable on the current teaching surface. Do not borrow pronunciation from a component-name example character or from unrelated dictionary/classical glyph readings.
